_about: Evidence per requirement ID for the items queued after layer 8 besides case management (docs/plans/queued-status.md): Brother badge printing (ADR-0047), CJIS mutual-aid grants, iOS readiness. Earlier evidence is kept and this work's appended after 'queued:'. tools/reqindex/traceability.py merges it last.
BRD:FR-13.05: scan verification POST /badges/verify (routes/field-ops.ts); checkpoint screen with camera scan or typed code (apps/field/app/checkpoint.tsx); queued: the console's badge print view sized to the county's Brother QL-820NWB (62 mm x 100 mm) and QL-1110NWB (4 in x 6 in) labels or a letter page, printed through the operating system's Brother driver (@page and label-sized styles, apps/web-console/src/screens/fieldops.tsx, styles.css); the label chosen recorded with each print outcome (cg.badge.print_layout, 0113; the badge event's detail) (ADR-0047)
services/api/test/fieldops.db.test.ts (the layout rides with the print steps; an unknown label is refused)

Printing from the field app through Brother's mobile SDK waits on Adam: the SDK is a licensed binary, not a package, and would add a native module to the Android CI build (ADR-0047). Camera scanning and a physical print on the real printers are checked on a device by a person.
SEC-12: compose.cjis.yaml (own internal network cg_cjis; cjis-db, cjis-keys, cjis-idp, cjis-api, cjis-worker, cjis-web, cjis-gateway on 127.0.0.1:8443 only); packages/cjis-db (own schema, roles, dictionary, RLS per agency); services/cjis-api (own token checks, policy E1–E6, audit, per-agency encryption); apps/web-cjis on its own origin (ADR-0038); platform holds only mission.cji_ref (packages/db 0041) and its dictionary refuses a cji column; ADR-0021, ADR-0036, ADR-0037 ; queued: mutual aid (decision 2026-10-15): cjis.record_share (packages/cjis-db 0006, dictionary) with row-level policies that let the agency a record is shared with read the record and its people, weapons, body-camera references and events while the share stands; policy actions record.share, record.share.revoke, record.share.read, and E3 opened for reads only when the record is shared (services/cjis-api/src/policy.ts); POST /records/:ref/shares (supervisor or agency administrator of the owner, with confirmation, at most 90 days, one standing share per agency), POST .../shares/:id/revoke with a reason, GET /agencies, shared records in GET /records with sharedBy and sharedUntil, every read under a share audited against the reader's agency with the owner named (services/cjis-api/src/routes/records.ts); the worker's mutual-aid job ends shares at their time with a record event and an audit row (services/cjis-api/src/jobs.ts endExpiredShares); the enclave web app's 'Shared with other agencies' panel, read-only banner and 'Shared by' column (apps/web-cjis/src/screens/records.tsx); the exercise shares the sheriff's record with the city police for 30 days (provision/exercise.ts)

tests/integration/layer5.int.test.ts (marker absent from the platform database and every log, ciphertext only in the enclave database, tokens refused across the boundary, field sync carries no link), tests/integration/stack.int.test.ts (network isolation, password alone refused, lockout), services/cjis-api/test/api.db.test.ts, packages/cjis-db/test/enclave.db.test.ts, services/cjis-api/test/token.test.ts, services/cjis-api/test/policy.test.ts, services/cjis-api/test/realm.test.ts, services/api/test/cjislink.db.test.ts, packages/db/test/dictionary.test.ts, tests/e2e/cjis.spec.ts, tests/e2e/console-l5.spec.ts; queued: services/cjis-api/test/api.db.test.ts (mutual aid: officer cannot share, own agency, past and over-90-day refused, one standing share, the helper reads and lists but cannot write, its read is audited with the owner named, a lapsed officer reads nothing, expiry ends the share and hides the record, early revoke with a reason, a helper cannot revoke), services/cjis-api/test/policy.test.ts (E3 shared read allowed, writes and sharing denied)

Holds no real CJI until it runs in an authorized government cloud and has passed the state CJIS audit (SCL-12; production refuses to start without CJIS_AUTHORIZED_ENVIRONMENT and CJIS_STATE_AUDIT_PASSED_ON). FIPS 140-validated keys, mutual TLS and a separate cloud account come with that move (plan §11). The CJIS values (ADR-0036) are to be confirmed by the agency's CJIS Systems Officer. Mutual aid stays inside one enclave: two agencies share a record only when both are tenants of the same enclave; sharing across enclaves or with the platform is not built.
FLD-02: PIN or biometric unlock, encrypted store, ten wrong PINs clear it (apps/field/app/unlock.tsx, src/vault*.ts); cg.field_device and remote wipe of app data (routes/roster.ts, field-sync.ts); screenshots and screen recording blocked on every screen except sign-in, unlock, job aids and settings (packages/field-core/src/screens.ts default deny, apps/field/src/privacy.native.ts with expo-screen-capture, app/_layout.tsx); queued: the iOS build configuration (apps/field/app.json: bundle identifier shared with Android, build number, background location only while checked in with every permission text, Face ID text, English and Spanish, Apple's privacy manifest with no tracking; app.config.js takes the county's gateway and code from the environment so one checkout builds for any county; pnpm prebuild:ios) and the build, device-check and distribution guide for Adam's Mac (docs/operations/field-app-ios.md; decision 2026-10-15)

services/api/test/field.db.test.ts (remote wipe ends the shift), packages/field-core/test/sync.test.ts (wipe clears every collection), services/api/test/dispatch-sync.db.test.ts (wipe rides along on sync), packages/field-core/test/screens.test.ts (screens with personal details blocked, new screens blocked by default); queued: apps/field/test/ios-config.test.ts (identifier, background mode, permission texts, privacy manifest, localizations, no product or county name in the build)

Enrolment and single-app mode are set in the device management system and need no app code; reading managed (MDM) app configuration is not built. The native screenshot block, encrypted stores and wipe are checked on a device by a person. The iOS build itself is made and checked on a device by Adam (docs/operations/field-app-ios.md §3).
